messages:
maya: Opened PR to add an installer preflight for air-gapped installs + a short KMS cert-rotation how-to. Link: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/482. PTAL for wording and the example flows.
jess: On it. Quick Q — do we show the rotation run from the bastion (operator SSH) or from the on-prem controller? examples differ.
maya: Added both flows in the draft: a lightweight 'bastion curl' path and a 'local orchestrator' systemd unit for orchestration. Paste below.
jess: Can you inline the curl + proxy example so I can copy it to the SDK snippets section?
maya: ```bash
# bastion -> KMS (air-gapped) via internal HTTP proxy
export PROXY=http://proxy.internal:3128
curl --proxy "\$PROXY" --fail -X POST 'http://kms.local:8080/v1/rotate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KMS_SERVICE_TOKEN>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"rotate": true}' \
  -sS
# recommended: pin CA with --cacert /etc/ssl/certs/kms-ca.pem
```
maya: ```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/kms-rotate.service
[Unit]
Description=Trigger KMS cert rotation
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/kms-rotate --endpoint http://kms.local:8080 --token-file /etc/kms/token

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
dave: LGTM for the flow. Two small nits: add `--fail` (you already did) and emphasize using `--cacert` for pinned CA in air-gapped environments — do not use `--insecure`. Also mention token scoping for the rotation API.
maya: Good catch, updated the snippet and added a short note about token scope: service token must include `kms.rotate` scope and be rotated via Vault/KMS bootstrap. Also added a caution about rotating CA only with support on hand.
oleg: Can we add a crosslink to the onprem networking checklist? the bastion approach needs NAT/DNS hints and port matrix.
docs-bot: Added placeholder link: docs/onprem/networking-checklist.md#bastion-flow (please replace with final anchor if the checklist moves).
infra-bot: FYI I added a CI integration test that runs the minimal preflight in a container network namespace. Test id: preflight-airgap-rot-7a — it will fail CI if `kms.local` is not resolvable or curl can't reach the endpoint.
jess: :thumbsup: One more ask — add a troubleshooting FAQ entry for `curl: (7) could not connect` and DNS/NAT debugging steps.
maya: Done, added two troubleshooting bullets (check /etc/hosts for kms.local, test `ip netns exec`, and verify proxy ACLs). Also trimmed installer step numbers to match the quickstart flow.
dave: Quick pass done, pushed a tiny grammar fix and clarified the token example.
oleg: If this merges, we should announce in #eng-runtime so runtime folks can check the CI test expectations.
maya: Thanks everyone — ready to merge after one last eyeball.
dave: Merged with squash, will follow up if runtime CI flags anything. :shipit:
